app.name: 100 Cities Club
landing.hero.subtitle: Indonesia is Southeast Asia's largest economy and the only ASEAN member of the G20. It is the world's 16th-largest economy by nominal GDP (~US$1.5 trillion) and 8th by purchasing-power parity (~US$5.4 trillion), home to 287 million people. Its next decade will be defined by urbanization: new cities, new industrial nodes, new towns that create jobs, train talent, and lift local economies. 100 Cities Club is a private, invitation-based initiative convened by PT Kawasan Industri Jababeka Tbk (IDX: KIJA) — Indonesia's pioneer township and industrial-estate developer — to lead this national effort. The goal is to support the building of 100 cities across Indonesia, in partnership with central and local government, Indonesian entrepreneurs, and global capital.
landing.cred.lead: The 100 Cities Club connects with Indonesian township developer PT Kawasan Industri Jababeka Tbk (IDX: KIJA). KIJA brings 35+ years of experience building integrated townships, industrial parks, power, water, dry ports, universities and teaching hospitals; the Club opens that playbook — and Indonesia itself — to global partners: manufacturers, investors, technology providers, developers, education and healthcare institutions.
